support_spans: On day 9 of therapy, he reported loss of appetite and malaise, followed by generalized pruritus, dark urine, and jaundice.
He was started on oral Alfuzosin 10 mg once daily.
candidates.why: The patient developed liver injury symptoms after starting Alfuzosin therapy.
